predicates.triState: UNKNOWN distinct from FALSE and TRUE; unavailable damage=0 vote but separately unevaluable
predicates.f1: currentState.state == DROP; source UNKNOWN is unevaluable; all other known states 0
predicates.f2: critical={HIGHER_LOW,CONTINUATION,RECLAIM,COMPRESSION_EXPANSION}; only known TRUE/FALSE counted; known>=2 AND FALSE_count>TRUE_count gives 1; known=0/1 unevaluable; one FALSE alone never votes
predicates.f2Resolution: The handoff's single-FALSE prohibition resolves the Boolean shorthand FALSE>TRUE for known=1; known>=2 is required before a family vote.
predicates.currentNet: fresh closed path close at now-1 and effectiveEntryPrice>0; R34 as-of percent=100*(close/entry-1.0005); no future/open mark
predicates.upRun: consecutive strictly rising adjacent scheduled closed closes ending now-1; require both now-1 and immediately preceding scheduled closed close, otherwise UNKNOWN; flat/down gives known 0; break at first nonrise or missing earlier close
predicates.f3: currentNet<=0 AND upRun==0 with both known; otherwise 0, missing either unevaluable
predicates.f4: facts.signalLossN>0 OR facts.failedRecovery==TRUE; true if either observed positive; false/evaluable only if both observed and nonpositive; otherwise UNKNOWN/0
predicates.damageScore: F1+F2+F3+F4 integer 0..4; R54 D, A/HIGH/LOW, Pattern187, short_negative excluded
predicates.p3: known critical TRUE>=1 AND FALSE_count<=TRUE_count; UNKNOWN gives no positive
predicates.veto: preservationScore>=2; unknown never interpreted as true/false
predicates.evaluableFamilies: count of F1-F4 with sufficient source evidence per predicates; 0 vote and unevaluable remain distinct
predicates.dataUnavailable: two adjacent closed checkpoints with evaluableFamilies<2 disables early EXIT and delegates to Control

anchor: For each Frozen Entry, scan exact R45 row identities in increasing closed NOW, from Entry through saved R50 Control decisionNow inclusive; FIRST_DAMAGE_EVENT is first such NOW with score>=1. One anchor at most; save no-anchor count and reason; R54 controller trace must not select an anchor.

evaluator.usefulDefensive: R54 confirmed model sell plus known R34 paired candidate-control PnL>0, supplemental only
evaluator.futureFields: evaluator output only, never joined into runtime predicates
evaluator.primaryComparison: archived IM79/R1 32; all missing evaluator labels reported and excluded from AUC, never replaced

auc.sample: anchored primary Entries with known label only
auc.resampleUnit: session cluster; sort unique primary 24 sessions, sample same number with replacement using Python random.Random(52), retain all anchored IM/R1 rows from sampled session with multiplicity
auc.ci: ordinary percentile 2.5%,97.5% using linear interpolation at p*(N-1) over sorted valid AUCs
auc.invalid: replicate with single class omitted and counted; fewer than 9500 valid means NO_GO; point AUC undefined means NO_GO
auc.direction: per-arm anchored AUC>=0.5 with both classes, otherwise NO_GO

secondary: anchored all-entry IM819/R1 795: defense(<5) median Damage Score >= winner(>=5) median for each arm; >=10 and no-anchor reported separately, not a separate GO test
diagnostics: damage score and F1-F4 by class
unknown and evaluable family count by cause
R54 negative winner-delta tail worst1/3/5 and minimum trades covering half
